name: setup-manaflow-ai-linen-look
description: A whole cmux look built only from public surfaces, after a consumer chat app: theme files for color, flat chrome and proportions (Linen, light, the default; Linen Dark), settings for a centered 768 px reading column in larger type, a history sidebar of recent chats with their age and hover controls, a quiet Thinking line and spinner while work runs, a stylesheet of cmux.agentPane.style/1 tokens for gray prompt pills and soft rounded menus, and a customize view for its preview hover card. Remove it and everything you had comes back.

files.customize/cmux-app.json:
{
  "$schema": "https://cmux.dev/schemas/cmux-app/2.json",
  "manifestVersion": 2,
  "id": "local/customize",
  "name": { "en": "Linen sidebar" },
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "description": "Linen's hover card and sidebar rows: a message-preview card (title and age, then a gray preview) and plain history rows with a thin spinner.",
  "engines": { "cmux": "^2.0" },
  "repository": "https://github.com/local/customize",
  "runtime": { "main": "main.js" },
  "implements": {
    "cmux.hovercard/1": { "export": "renderCard" },
    "cmux.sidebar.rows/1": { "export": "decorateRows" }
  },
  "scopes": { "workspace:read": "Name the rows to decorate." },
  "activation": ["onInterface:cmux.hovercard/1", "onInterface:cmux.sidebar.rows/1"],
  "files": ["main.js"]
}
